Do you want to earn a good salary and choose your working days? Then get started at Kuehne Nagel in Maarssen. They are open both during the week and in the weekend. This way you can work whenever you want! In addition, you can earn high allowances in the evenings and on the weekend. Yes! Apply now as a production employee at Kuehne Nagel in Maarssen.

We do not provide housing or sponsorships

What we offer
- High allowances in the evening and on the weekend
- Earn € 14,99 per hour excl. allowances
- Enthusiastic colleagues around you
- Chance to get a fixed contract after 10 weeks!

Who you are
As a production employee at Kuehne Nagel, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You are willing to work in two shifts: 6:00-15:00 and 14:45 – 23:45
- You are available at least 3 days a week from Monday to Sunday. You choose!
- You speak Dutch or English
- You can work in Maarssen
- Please note that a VOG screening is part of your application process

What will you do
If you start working as a production employee at Kuehne Nagel, you will have a varied job. You will process the returns from Albert Heijn. One moment you are busy with the packaging of empty crates and bottles and you make sure that they are sorted and placed in the right place. The next moment you as a production employee are processing the returned food (that could no longer be sold). You make sure that the products are neatly separated. Another moment you may help unload the trucks with the products. Then you take them to the right place in the warehouse. Your work is very diverse!

Where will you work
Kuehne Nagel in Utrecht has three locations. You will work as a production employee in the distribution center in Maarssen. This is where all returned products from Albert Heijn that can no longer be sold end up. You will work in an international team with enthusiastic colleagues. There is an informal working atmosphere. So it feels like coming home

- In addition to Sunday, you must also be available on Monday and Tuesday.

- You are available between 4:30 PM and 2:00 AM.

As a logistics employee, you make sure everything in the warehouse runs smoothly, safely, and in an organised way. You play an important role in the logistics process within a modern and dynamic metal company.

Your tasks include receiving, checking, and processing incoming goods, picking and preparing orders for shipment, and loading and unloading trucks. You also keep track of stock levels, handle simple administration, and think along about ways to make processes smarter and more efficient. Together with your colleagues, you help maintain a clean and safe working environment.
